technical-summary: #1169: live-policy calibration has its own key (policy_calibration_inputs of the written manifest), shared by the calibration run and the production manifest writer; host pool, helper budgets, engine args and engine build are provenance, not key. Fixes production serving without the policy since Nov 9 (record orphaned by #790) and a calibration run filing its record under a key production never looked up. Legacy hash-only records are refused with a reason.
user-summary-candidate: The Flash-Next live expert-placement policy turns on again after calibration and survives rebuilds.
